text:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv_cache_evictions spiking on rope-prod-us-east-1. p50 latency 3x baseline. alert_id=KV-ALRM-2310 — paging #incidents @oncall
micah: grabbing this — starting triage. seeing large number of unique KV keys being created, looks like a prefetch pattern.
eli: confirming, continuous-batching consumers are thrashing. ntk_window_length has grown on rope nodes that got the new longctx rollout. KV card went from ~800k -> ~6.2M in 15m.
jana: that rollout was longctx-rope-v3.1 at 07:12UTC, enabled sliding-window prefetch by default.
micah: exact symptom: massive prefix cache entries from long context prefetch and sliding-window overlap. eviction loop plus async prefetch creates storm.
frida: customer-impact: two Dedicated customers (acme-eu, vector-jp) reporting 5xx spikes and degraded response times; support ticket 4521 and 4522 opened. CS pinged.
micah: mitigation plan (short): 1) disable sliding-window prefetch feature flag on rope-prod-us-east-1, 2) temporarily reduce continuous_batch.max_batch_size from 64 -> 8, 3) set kv.eviction_policy to aggressive for affected nodes. execute in that order.
eli: +1. quick queries: `sum(kv.prefetch_requests{cluster="rope-prod-us-east-1"}) by (instance)` shows huge skews. I'll tail logs and run the flag toggle once micah confirms.
micah: running toggle now — calling deploy API.
micah: ```bash
# disable sliding window prefetch for rope
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/flags/slide_prefetch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"clusters":["rope-prod-us-east-1"],"value":false}'
```
deploy-bot: CONFIG-APPLY: flag slide_prefetch=false applied to rope-prod-us-east-1 by micah (change-id=c-23100001).
eli: metrics check: kv.used_bytes peak ~1.2TB -> 420GB within 6m after toggle. evictions/sec down from 24k -> 3.1k. batch_latency_p95 back to ~220ms.
micah: pushed batch config change (max_batch_size=8) to target group rope-inference-consumers.
deploy-bot: CONFIG-APPLY: continuous_batch.max_batch_size=8 applied to rope-inference-consumers by micah (change-id=c-23100002).
jana: question: do we want to rollback longctx-rope-v3.1 entirely or keep model but keep prefetch off? rollback risks model-quality regression for customer apps.
micah: preference: keep model rollout but with prefetch disabled + lower batch sizes. If we still see cost/eviction issues in 30m, we'll rollback model to v3.0.
frida: I'll draft a short customer note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx/errors tied to long-context prefetch; mitigation in progress; will update within 1h" — sending to CS.
eli: running sanity query for tail errors per customer: `topk(10, sum(rate(http_errors_total[5m])) by (customer))` shows acme-eu and vector-jp top. Ticket owners notified.
oncall-bot: HANDOFF: night oncall @eli will take ownership in 2 hours. Please post any runbook + links.
micah: adding runbook snippet: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-prefetch-throttle — includes rollback steps and quick toggles.
micah: quick note: avoid mass rolling restarts; changes are config toggles, no rollout needed.
eli: monitoring dashboard updated, added alert dampening for kv.evictions to reduce noise. also started a background job to compact hot prefixes.
jana: we should add a short-term throttle: per-customer prefetch cap to avoid single customer creating high cardinality. can we gate that fast?
micah: yes, I can flip `prefetch.per_customer_cap=1000` for rope cluster. applying now.
micah: `curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/flags/prefetch_cap" -d '{"value":1000,"clusters":["rope-prod-us-east-1"]}'` -> applied.
eli: after both toggles, observed queue depth normalized and tail latency stable.
frida: customer comms sent for acme-eu and vector-jp, GA ticket numbers attached.
micah: marking mitigation as effective. still monitoring for 45m.
eli: running longer-run mem profiles to ensure no memory leak from prefetch code path.
frida: summary for handoff: removed sliding-window prefetch, reduced batch sizes, set per-customer prefetch cap, aggressive eviction policy. customer-impact partial (5xx for two Dedicated customers), mitigated.
oncall-bot: NOTE: please escalate to SE if repeat incidents or if rollback is required during night shift.
jana: assigning follow-up postmortem to micah + eli. expected deliverable: timeline, root cause (prefetch + longctx sliding overlap), and recommended permanent controls (per-customer caps, prefetch circuit-breaker, rollout gating).
micah: ack. I'll draft postmortem and link to incident ticket 2310-KV-Surge.
eli: handing off monitoring to night; will keep alerting thresholds relaxed to avoid flapping.
frida: closing customer comm loop after final verification.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by mitigations at ts=2310001583. last_message=2310001987.
micah: final note: doing a small canary test before re-enabling sliding-window in future — must require preflight telemetry quota and per-customer caps.
eli: ack, will include gating in rollout checklist.
frida: postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow.
micah: leaving channel, leaving runbook pointers + commands in incident ticket. :thumbsup:
